fields.validation: One to four unique ISO3 codes when required; unknown stays explicit.
fields.prompt: Which citizenships should this scenario use?
fields.help_text: Citizenship can change route applicability and is never inferred from residence.

fields.validation: One ISO3 code or unknown.
fields.prompt: Where do you currently live?
fields.help_text: Requested only when current residence affects the supported route.

fields.validation: 0 to 120 at the scenario snapshot date.
fields.prompt: What age should this scenario use?
fields.help_text: Requested only when a supported route has an age condition.

fields.validation: Past date; exception-only when an exact dated age boundary cannot use age in years.
fields.prompt: What is the relevant birth date?
fields.help_text: Asked only for an exact legal age boundary; age in years is preferred.

fields.validation: User text plus optional versioned taxonomy mapping; unresolved text is preserved.
fields.prompt: What occupation are you considering?
fields.help_text: Occupation titles are mapped only when a source-supported taxonomy match exists.

fields.validation: 0 to 80 in half-year increments.
fields.prompt: How many years of relevant experience do you have?
fields.help_text: Continuity is not inferred.

fields.validation: Declared level, field, awarding country, institution and year; recognition is not inferred.
fields.prompt: Which qualifications should be considered?
fields.help_text: A qualification declaration is separate from official recognition.

fields.validation: Language plus self-assessed level or named test evidence.
fields.prompt: What language evidence should be considered?
fields.help_text: Language ability is never inferred from citizenship.

fields.validation: None, spouse, civil partner, unmarried partner or unknown.
fields.prompt: Is a partner part of this scenario?
fields.help_text: Destination evidence defines which relationships qualify.

fields.validation: True, false or unknown when a partner is declared.
fields.prompt: Would your partner relocate in this scenario?
fields.help_text: This describes the scenario, not the relationship itself.

fields.validation: Work, study, neither or unknown.
fields.prompt: Would your partner want to work or study?
fields.help_text: Used only to explain supported partner rights.

fields.validation: Role and age band only; names are prohibited.
fields.prompt: Which dependent children are part of this scenario?
fields.help_text: Declare roles and broad age bands without names.

fields.validation: 0 to 25; exact ages only when a supported rule needs them.
fields.prompt: What exact child ages apply?
fields.help_text: Asked only when an age band cannot resolve a supported rule.

fields.validation: One or more unique stable destination ISO3 codes.
fields.prompt: Which destinations should be checked?
fields.help_text: Unsupported destinations remain explicit and do not produce a negative applicant conclusion.

fields.validation: A valid snapshot date; future checks are marked provisional.
fields.prompt: When should the rules be checked?
fields.help_text: Only evidence effective on this date may be used.

fields.validation: Present, absent or unknown plus role, region, sponsorship and optional salary; no employer name.
fields.prompt: Do you have a relevant job offer?
fields.help_text: Employer identity is not needed for the initial check.

fields.validation: Unique canonical region IDs or explicit unresolved values.
fields.prompt: Is a specific region relevant?
fields.help_text: Requested only when a supported route varies by region.

fields.validation: A supported primary route ID or explicit unknown.
fields.prompt: Which work or study route is the household joining?
fields.help_text: The dependant check cannot operate as general family-reunification advice.

fields.validation: Official register ID where supported; user text and unresolved identity are retained in the snapshot.
fields.prompt: Which institution is relevant?
fields.help_text: An unresolved institution produces input required or insufficient evidence, not a guessed match.

fields.validation: Versioned broad qualification level with unknown allowed.
fields.prompt: What qualification level applies?
fields.help_text: Post-study routes may differ by qualification level.

fields.validation: User text plus optional versioned taxonomy mapping.
fields.prompt: What field of study applies?
fields.help_text: Requested only when a supported route distinguishes fields.

fields.validation: 1 to 120 months.
fields.prompt: How long is or was the course?
fields.help_text: Minimum duration rules are evaluated without inferring attendance.

fields.validation: In person, hybrid, online or unknown.
fields.prompt: How is or was the course delivered?
fields.help_text: Physical-presence rules may distinguish study modes.

fields.validation: A valid date plus completed, current or planned state.
fields.prompt: When was or will the course be completed?
fields.help_text: Application windows and provisional wording depend on completion timing.
